🔒 Protect Backup File
This backup contains full student PII and financial records. Set a password to encrypt the downloaded file (AES-256) — anyone who opens the raw file without the password will see nothing usable.

Review the current year's status before closing it.
Class Promotion Preview
⚠ This operation cannot be undone. The current year will be archived and students will be promoted. Review all options carefully.
Promote students to next class
For any class with an approved Promotion Management list, each student's individual decision (promote/repeat/graduate/withdraw) is used. Classes with no approved list fall back to promoting every student one level up (Basic 6 → Graduated). Students already Left/Expelled/Graduated are skipped either way.
Carry forward outstanding fee arrears
Students with unpaid balances will have arrears added to their Term 1 bill in the new year.
Mark current year as archived
Sets a read-only archive flag on this year's data. You can still view it by switching years.
Reset fee payments in new year
New year starts with clean payment records. Arrears (above) are carried separately.

📋 Feeding Fee Notes
  • Enter the daily feeding rate and the number of school days for each term.
  • The term total and annual total are calculated automatically.
  • Feeding fees cover daily lunch and mid-morning snack.
  • Parents who opt out must notify the school before term begins.
  • Feeding fee arrears are tracked separately from school fee arrears.

SSNIT Contributions (Tier 1 — 12.5%)
Employee: 5.5% · Employer: 12.5% of basic salary. Employer 12.5% includes Tier 1 (10%) credited to SSNIT Trust Fund and Tier 2 (3%) to employee's pension scheme.

Tier 2 — Occupational Pension
Employee contributes 4.5% and Employer contributes 0.5% of basic salary to a licensed Tier 2 pension scheme (separate from SSNIT Tier 1).

🧩 Fee Components
Break each term's total fee into named line items (Tuition, PTA Dues, Sports, etc.) for clearer invoices and receipts. The components' sum automatically becomes the class's fee for that term in the Fee Schedule.
Components are picked from your Chart of Accounts → Revenue accounts, so what's charged always ties back to the books. Manage the list itself in Chart of Accounts.
Components Total GHS 0.00
🏦 Add Bank Transaction
Use this for movements that only ever hit the bank account directly — bank charges, interest earned, transfers, or a manual balance adjustment. Fee payments, revenue, and expenses tagged "Bank" already flow in automatically.
✅ Bank Reconciliation Statement
Reconciles the Cash Book (system) balance to the Bank Statement balance by listing genuine timing differences — items your books already reflect that the bank hasn't processed yet, or vice versa. This is a record; it doesn't change any figures on its own.
🏦 Account:
Balance as per Cash Book
—
Adjusted Balance
—
Difference
—
➕ Add: Unpresented Cheques / Payments
Recorded as paid out in the Cash Book, but the bank hasn't cleared them yet — the bank still holds this money.
➖ Less: Deposits in Transit
Recorded as received in the Cash Book, but the bank hasn't credited them yet.
📝 Manual Journal Entry
For anything that doesn't come from Revenue, Expenses, Fee Payments, Petty Cash, Bank Account, Payroll, or Asset Management — e.g. correcting an entry, or a transaction unique to this school. Every entry must balance: total debits must equal total credits.

➕ Add New Account
Adds a new category to Revenue or Expense Tracker, gives it a real Chart of Accounts entry, and adds it to Budgeting with its own budget line — all in one step.
ℹ Sets an opening balance via a Manual Journal Entry against Suspense/Adjustments — this shows up on the Balance Sheet immediately. Leave blank to start at zero and post journal entries later from the General Ledger page.
🎟️ Fee Discounts & Exemptions
Configure a discount or full exemption for an individual student — applies automatically everywhere their fees are calculated (Payment Tracker, Balance Sheet, Income Statement, reports). Separate from the "Scholarship" admission status, which already fully waives fees.
